name: Tokoyo Sarasa
source:
If you wanted to sound nice, you'd call her relaxed, gentle person. Or, to put it bluntly, she's just carefree.

Third year student, preparing for final exams and graduation next year. However she isn't concerned too much about her future. Still unsure, which way would be best.

One day, after seeing a certain dream, she decided to investigate legends and traditions related to town's shrine as a summer homework assignment. She always carries a charm, which she treasures greatly, even though she doesn't remember when and how she got it.

Also, she sleeps a lot.

[translated from manual]

[spoiler][url=/c9958]Towa[/url]'s estranged older sister[/spoiler]
